mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_send_rate_window(user_id,window_start,window_seconds,used_count,expires_at) VALUES(#{userId},#{start},#{seconds},0,#{expires}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=user_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_send_rate_window WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND window_start=#{start} AND window_seconds=#{seconds} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_send_rate_window SET used_count=used_count+1 WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND window_start=#{start} AND window_seconds=#{seconds}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_send_rate_window WHERE expires_at<=#{cutoff} ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{limit}
